text: Childminder here, I've had a 2 year old girl overnight since her mum's on nights. Temp 39.3. Her nappy has been dry since this morning, I'm counting nearly 13 hours now with not one wet one. The strange thing is her hands and feet are freezing cold and she's shivering, even though she's burning up with the fever. I've been up with her for hours and I'm wrecked, I can't tell if I'm overthinking or not thinking enough.
